the role of airway E- NTPDases in the regulation of purinergic signaling and the development of chronic lung diseases.
the role of nucleotides in lung diseases, and with the mechanisms that regulate their concentrations.

the regulation of airway nucleotide metabolism is an important determinant of the outcome of chronic airway diseases.
